## Overview GLM-5.3-Flash prefill convolution produces strided Q/K/V slices that FlashKDA copies into three contiguous buffers. Produce dense `[3, tokens, projection_dim]` output directly in the existing convolution to eliminate those copies. ## Claims - Automatically enable the producer for pure-prefill SM90/BF16/D128 FlashKDA, preserving convolution arithmetic, cache updates and raw projections used for checkpoint export. - Full-model profiles on all four H200 ranks show **4 → 1 copy kernels per FlashKDA prefill**. The three Q/K/V copies are eliminated; the native beta transpose remains. - Same-GPU serial A/B, ISL2048/OSL1, RPS=inf, Rust benchmark client: **2.83% higher median throughput**, from **21.130 to 21.728 requests/s**, across three runs per arm. ## Validation ### Before [baseline-dp0_pp0_tp0_dcp0_ep0_rank0.perfetto.pt.trace.json.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33468759/baseline-dp0_pp0_tp0_dcp0_ep0_rank0.perfetto.pt.trace.json.gz) Four copy kernels: three Q/K/V contiguous copies plus one beta transpose. ### After [producer-dp0_pp0_tp0_dcp0_ep0_rank0.perfetto.pt.trace.json.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33468763/producer-dp0_pp0_tp0_dcp0_ep0_rank0.perfetto.pt.trace.json.gz) Only the beta transpose remains; the convolution produces dense Q/K/V directly. ### End-to-end prefill throughput 4 NVIDIA H200, GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 checkpoint/BF16 KDA projections, TP2/DP2/EP, MTP3 and default CUDA graphs. Each arm used a separate 64-request warmup, then three 1,000-request runs with seeds 102, 104 and 106. No client concurrency cap; server `max_num_seqs` uses its default. All 6,000 measured requests succeeded with exact ISL2048/OSL1. For measured repeats, use seeds 102, 104 and 106.

files.patch:
@@ -187,9 +187,12 @@ steps:
   device: h200_35gb
   source_file_dependencies:
   - vllm/models/glm5next/
+  - vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/ops/causal_conv1d.py
   - tests/models/glm5next/
+  - tests/kernels/mamba/test_causal_conv1d.py
   commands:
     - pytest -v -s models/glm5next
+    - pytest -v -s kernels/mamba/test_causal_conv1d.py -k dense_qkv
   mirror:
     amd:
       label: ":amd: (MI355 DPX) GLM5Next"

@@ -17,6 +17,112 @@
 
 DEVICE = current_platform.device_type
 
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="H200 producer path")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("projection_dim", [127, 4096])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("has_bias", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("state_dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dim_first", [False, True])
+def test_causal_conv1d_dense_qkv_preserves_varlen_output_and_state(
+    projection_dim, has_bias, state_dtype, dim_first
+):
+    """Grouped stores preserve output/cache through eager and graph replay."""
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import compute_causal_conv1d_metadata
+
+    torch.manual_seed(19)
+    lengths = [1, 3, 17] if projection_dim == 127 else [2048, 7]
+    dim, total = 3 * projection_dim, sum(lengths)
+    x = torch.randn(total, dim + 64, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)[:, :dim]
+    weight = torch.randn(dim, 4, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.1
+    bias = torch.randn(dim, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32) if has_bias else None
+    storage = torch.randn(9, dim * 3 + 8, device=DEVICE, dtype=state_dtype)
+    baseline_storage = storage.clone()
+
+    def cache_view(data):
+        shape = (dim, 3) if dim_first else (3, dim)
+        view = data[:, : dim * 3].view(9, *shape)
+        return view if dim_first else view.transpose(-1, -2)
+
